name: SpendZero: No Spend Challenge
subtitle: No-Buy Tracker & Savings Game
promotionalText: New in 2.0: every no-spend day drops a gold coin into your Coin Vault. Fill your year with gold, check your savings forecast and seal the day from your Lock Screen.
description:
Don't spend. Mint gold. SpendZero turns every no-spend day into a gold coin: watch them pile up in your Coin Vault, fill your year on the Mint Calendar and see what a year of not spending could be worth. Streaks, XP, quests, badges and a living wealth tree make it a game you'll actually want to win. Every loonie you don't spend counts.

Doing a no-buy month, a low-buy year or No-Spend January, or just trying to stop impulse buying? SpendZero makes every day you don't spend feel like a win.

NEW IN 2.0
• Coin Vault: each sealed day drops a gold coin into a glass jar you can tilt and shake
• Mint Calendar: your whole year in gold coins, brighter on the days you kept more
• Savings forecast, all-new charts, and what your savings could buy
• Monthly Recap: your month as a story, ready to share
• Seal the day from your Lock Screen, the Dynamic Island, Control Centre or Siri
• A living wealth tree: day and night, the seasons, holiday lights in December
• Unlock Gold, Emerald and Midnight app icons as you level up

A GAME YOU WIN BY NOT SPENDING
Mark a no-spend day and it's stamped with a gold coin. Your streak counts up, rewards pop in, and you see how close your next milestone is.
• Streaks, with streak freezes that save you on a bad day
• Daily and weekly quests that progress from what you actually do
• 25 levels, from Frugal Novice to Wealth King
• Badges for 7-, 30-, 100- and 365-day streaks and savings milestones
• Challenges like the 30-Day No-Spend Challenge, Coffee Detox Week and seasonal ones like No-Spend January, or create your own

GROW YOUR WEALTH TREE
Your tree is one of a kind. It grows with every level, hangs gold coins as your savings pile up and follows your real day, from sunrise to moonlit nights. Let your streak slip and it starts to wilt; one no-spend day brings it back.

CRUSH IMPULSE BUYS
Felt the urge to buy? Log it. Resist it and the money counts as saved, with XP to prove it. Gave in? No shame: log it and keep going. Groceries and transportation don't break your no-spend day.

NEVER BREAK THE CHAIN
• Interactive widgets: seal the day without opening the app
• An optional evening countdown on your Lock Screen before the day runs out
• "Seal today in SpendZero" with Siri, or one tap in Control Centre
• A gentle evening check-in, plus a morning reminder if you forgot yesterday

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything you log stays on your iPhone. No account, no bank login, no ads, no tracking.

Available in English, French, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Danish, Dutch, Finnish, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
SpendZero Pro is available weekly, monthly or yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans may include a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel at any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gwlabs.app/privacy
